findings.text: A CRLF-to-LF edit inside a multiline SQL string preserves `sqlTextHash` but changes the string value that `sql_module` compiles, so the proposed check can accept stale build products. Fix: require a freshness check that distinguishes the original SQL bytes before accepting the module.

Lean 4.34.1 gives `instInhabitedParseNode` the class-token range but gives its directly referenced `instInhabitedParseNode.default` helper no range, so neither rule 3 nor rule 5 folds that helper. Fix: cover this range-free generated helper using its verified instance parent and include it in the deriving fixture.

Folding `Database.run.eq_1` into `Database.run` records a `type` edge to `Sql.run`, although `Sql.run` occurs only in the body of `Database.run`, contradicting ADR D7’s definition of `type`. Fix: specify in D7 that `type` and `body` describe the contributing constant before folding, and use that meaning for `used_in_a_type`.
